stories.title: Follow live: White Sox in front early as Astros look to respond in ALWC Game 1
Riley's clutch homer in 8th lifts Braves to G1 win over Phillies
stories.summary: Austin Riley hit a three-run homer off All-Star closer Jhoan Duran in the eighth inning, and the Braves rallied past the Phillies 5-3 on Tuesday in the opener their National League Wild Card Series.

stories.title: Sources: NBA reviewing finalists' bids for Vegas team in $12-13B range
stories.summary: The NBA is expected to select the winning bid for owner of the Las Vegas expansion team from among three finalist groups: Nancy Walton Laurie and Bill Laurie; Steve Apostolopoulos and Marc Lasry; and Bill Foley and Jerry Colangelo.

stories.title: Giants release OBJ amid veteran receiver's struggles
stories.summary: The Giants released veteran wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. on Tuesday.

stories.title: Divine intervention? Pope Leo blesses White Sox ahead of playoffs
stories.summary: The White Sox got a letter of support from Pope Leo XIV, a longtime fan and Chicago native, prior to Tuesday's playoff opener vs. the Astros.
